description: This file contains the implementation of the PartyWorker class, which provides utility methods for managing and querying party-related data within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for retrieving party details, creating IDs, and finding contact mechanisms, addresses, and related parties.

classes.name: PartyWorker
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for managing party-related data and queries within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getPartyOtherValues
methods.description: Retrieves party, person, and party group entities related to a given partyId and stores them in a map with specified attribute keys.

methods.name: createClubId
methods.description: Generates a sequenced club ID with a prefix, total length, and a check digit using Luhn algorithm.

methods.name: findPartyLatestContactMech
methods.description: Finds the most recent contact mechanism of a specified type for a given party.

methods.name: findPartyLatestPostalAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the latest postal address for a given party.

methods.name: findPartyLatestPostalAddressGeoPoint
methods.description: Retrieves the latest geolocation point associated with a party's postal address.

methods.name: findPartyLatestTelecomNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the latest telecom number for a party.

methods.name: findPartyLatestUserLogin
methods.description: Finds the most recent user login record for a party.

methods.name: findPartyLastLoginTime
methods.description: Retrieves the timestamp of the last login for a party.

methods.name: findPartyLastLocale
methods.description: Gets the last locale used by the party based on the most recent login.

methods.name: findFirstMatchingPartyId
methods.description: Finds the first party ID matching address and name criteria.

methods.name: findFirstMatchingPartyAndContactMechId
methods.description: Finds the first party and contact mechanism ID matching address and name criteria.

methods.name: findMatchingPersonPostalAddresses
methods.description: Finds postal addresses matching address and name criteria, returning a list of matching parties.

methods.name: findMatchingPartyPostalAddress
methods.description: Finds postal addresses matching address criteria, excluding disabled parties.

methods.name: makeMatchingString
methods.description: Converts an address string into a normalized form for matching, including uppercasing, mapping replacements, and removing non-word characters.

methods.name: getAssociatedPartyIdsByRelationshipType
methods.description: Retrieves a list of party IDs related by a specific relationship type.

methods.name: findPartiesById
methods.description: Finds parties by ID, with options to search in party or identification table.

methods.name: findParty
methods.description: Finds a single party entity by ID.

methods.name: findParties
methods.description: Finds multiple party entities by ID, including view entity handling.

methods.name: findPartyId
methods.description: Retrieves the party ID string for a given identification.
